Synthetic Treaty on Measurement Standards

This text is invented for software tests and is not a real treaty.

Article 1. The Parties agree that every measurement made under this Treaty is stated against a published standard.

Article 2. Each Party shall publish the standard it applies.

Article 3. The Parties shall inform one another of any change to the standard they apply.

Article 4. Any dispute about the application of a standard shall be settled by consultation between the Parties.

Article 5. This Treaty enters into force when the Parties have deposited their instruments.

Article 6. This Treaty exists in six synthetic language versions.

Article 7. The annexes form an integral part of this Treaty.

Article 8. Amendments to this Treaty are adopted by consensus of the Parties.
